title: File-upload security
proves: Hostile files (spoofed extensions, HTML or script bytes, active SVG, traversal names, padded markup, a zip that inflates past its declared size) are refused by the shared upload guards; every upload route is size-capped and on a reviewed list (a new route fails the ratchet); on the booted API no multipart operation accepts an unauthenticated upload.
doesNotProve: No authenticated live upload per route, no cross-tenant download or delete test, no real object store (S3), no antivirus scan (none exists), no image pixel-dimension limit, no CSV formula injection on import (export side is covered by vapt).
